entities.summary: Sivan Kailasavadivoo (b. 1957-04-14, Nagercoil) was a ethicist or moral philosopher of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Nagercoil and India. Known in the fields of india, ethicists & moralists, asia.
